name: health-band
description: A band above the prompt. Always: a gauge row with LSE requests today (LSE n/15000, yellow >10k, red >14k), helper-agent jobs today from the dispatch.sh logs, and the fixed per-turn context overhead of plugins and skills. Red/amber issue rows when launchd logs show Anthropic API credit errors, ~/.lse_key is missing or rejected, a live feed's newest bar is older than its market-minute limit, or a forward job is stale. Checks every 5 min; /healthband lists everything.
